name: Memory Compaction Redistill
description: Hypothesis-aware session compaction (previous summary + new history) and post-compaction sync to workspace memory + memory-lancedb-pro.

model.description: provider/model for compaction summarization and fact extraction.

auth.description: Auth mode hint for OpenClaw (e.g. api-key).

timeoutMs.description: Per-request LLM timeout for summarize/fact calls (max 30 min).

primaryProbeTimeoutMs.description: Fail-fast primary model probe before long compaction summarize.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature for compaction summaries (lower = more factual).

fallbacks.description: Ordered fallback provider/model ids when primary probe or call fails.

fallback.description: Secondary OpenAI-compatible endpoint credentials for a fallback model.

memoryLancedbProPath.description: Absolute path to memory-lancedb-pro plugin directory for LanceDB store imports.

syncToLancedb.description: Persist extracted decisions to LanceDB via memory-lancedb-pro store.

writeWorkspaceMemory.description: Write memory/compaction-sync/*.md with summary and session transcript reference.

memorySubdir.description: Relative path under agent workspace for compaction snapshots.

staging.description: Opt-in degrade recovery: chunk residue on disk; multi-pass only when queue non-empty.

enabled.description: When true, write staging chunks on fact-extract degrade and run multi-pass if queue non-empty.

chunkMaxChars.description: Required when staging.enabled — max chars per chunk (fail closed if missing).

llm.model.label: Compaction LLM
llm.model.help: Exact provider/model for redistill summarization (e.g. litellm/gemma4-26b-a4b or litellm/gemma4-26b-a4b).

llm.timeoutMs.label: LLM timeout (ms)
llm.timeoutMs.help: Per-request timeout for compaction summarize (schema max 1800000).

llm.primaryProbeTimeoutMs.label: Primary probe timeout (ms)
llm.primaryProbeTimeoutMs.help: Short fail-fast probe before skipping a dead/overloaded primary to fallbacks.

memoryLancedbProPath.label: memory-lancedb-pro Path
memoryLancedbProPath.help: Directory containing memory-lancedb-pro dist/ (sibling under workspace skills).

syncToLancedb.label: Sync To LanceDB
syncToLancedb.help: Store current decisions after each successful compaction.
